citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 10:52 AM on August
12, 2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee by phone, but both numbers were disconnected. Failure to
provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued
failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
Additional Inspectors:
Michael Tygart, VETERINARY MEDICAL OFFICEREnd Section
